name: salvage-refused-when-nothing-produced
description: A zstd stream cut inside its only block: it ended early AND produced nothing, so it is refused rather than salvaged.

error.detail: unexpected EOF with no output produced

grounding: Salvage requires two conjuncts, not one: the stream ended early *and* it produced something first. Dropping the second conjunct would land every corrupt capture as a silently empty turn, which reads downstream as a real but contentless turn rather than as a failure.
